# qfield-testbed

> Sandboxed, reproducible deployments of the QField stack (QFieldCloud, QGIS + QFieldSync, QField on Android, iOS or desktop) driven by the `qft` CLI, with a bisect mode to find the revision that introduced a regression. Every command answers in JSON with `--json`; `qft docs TOPIC` prints these pages for the installed version.
